title: Factory event processing and chain reorgs

options.name: Keep current behaviour: act on events at the head
options.risk: Events from reorged blocks trigger buys that fail; events re-included below lastBlock are missed.

options.name: Keep acting at the head and rescan the last few blocks each poll, deduplicated by pair
options.behavior_impact: Same speed; re-included events are caught.
options.risk: Dedup must be exact or a pair is dispatched twice (see BUY-03).

options.name: Act only after N confirmations
options.risk: Slower than other snipers by N blocks, which defeats the purpose of sniping.

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). The linked finding is S3.
behavior_impact: Decides how quickly the bot reacts to new pairs versus reorg safety.
needed_by: Phase 29 (or Phase 24 if Phase 23 shows impact)
